**Issues found in `src/lib.rs`:**
- `max_payload` parameter was completely ignored — no bounds check on payload length
- No checked arithmetic for frame size computation
- No allocation discipline (no `try_reserve`)
- Lossy `as u32` cast on `payload.len()` without overflow protection

- Added `payload.len() > max_payload` guard returning `FrameError::PayloadTooLarge`
- Added `checked_add(4)` for frame size with `FrameError::Overflow` fallback
- Added `try_reserve` with `FrameError::Allocation` fallback
- Replaced `as u32` cast with `u32::try_from` for safe width conversion
